orgName.title: Organization name
orgName.description: Shown to the user as: Managed by <orgName>.

level.title: Level (1 to 4)
level.description: 1 hide AI features, 2 also mute AI talk, 3 also hide AI-made content, 4 also block AI sites.

locked.title: Lock settings
locked.description: When true the user cannot pause, allow-list, or change the level.

allowSites.title: Sites where AI Off stays out of the way

muteExtraTerms.title: Extra words to mute at Level 2

configUrl.title: Hosted config URL (optional)
configUrl.description: Signed org config fetched every 15 minutes. Leave empty for static policy with no extra network calls.
